skills.description: Install the mfw (Semgrep Malware Firewall) CLI via the curl|sh installer and walk the user through setup — trust store, PATH shims, shell integration, and the background daemon — asking questions at real decision points. Use when the user wants to install, set up, or onboard mfw on this machine.
